programs.title: Nightmare Next Door
programs.desc: A series of programs presenting authentic stories of people who disappeared in strange circumstances, and during the investigation it turned out that they were murdered by family members, friends or neighbors whom they had known for years.Murders committed by people close to the victim occur much more often than is commonly believed.Investigations in such cases are difficult and often lead to shocking conclusions.The program used police photos and recordings, and a number of interviews were held with the victims' families.

programs.title: Evil Lives Here 2
programs.desc: A crime series telling terrifying stories that happened to ordinary people.The heroes find out that they live under the same roof as a murderer.They slowly discover more and more suspicious signals that they were unable or unwilling to read and understand.The life of those who decided to discover the terrible truth suddenly turns into real hell - their loved one, in whom they put all their trust and hope, turns out to be a ruthless monster.Viewers will learn what their reaction was and what steps they decided to take in this case - hand over their loved one to the police or help hide all evidence of the crime.
